text: Coffee with Chantal. Her dad's back in hospital with a chest infection, second time since the summer. She's driving up to see him Friday after work. Need to text her Saturday morning to see how he's doing.
Kofi and Lena got a puppy! Cocker spaniel called Biscuit, came home Sunday. Lena's already exhausted from the night wakings. Kofi says the vet check is Thursday at 4.

Long call with Yusuf. He did his ankle in at five a side, torn ligament not broken thank god. Physio starts sometime next week. His wife Petra is not impressed, says he's too old for it. He's bored stiff at home so I should pop round with some games at the weekend.
Adriana's cat Pepper has been off her food for days. Vet thinks kidneys, bloods back tomorrow afternoon. She's really worried.
Thomas mentioned his mum's knee replacement is finally booked for early March. He's taking two weeks off to look after her. Alice is covering his shifts.
Bumped into Varun at the station. Moving to Leeds sometime in the spring, job with the council. His daughter Kiara starts nursery there in September.
Emre's little boy has chickenpox so the party on Saturday is off. They'll redo it after half term probably. Don't forget to drop off something for Emre's lad, he loves dinosaurs.
Hoang - migraines getting worse, finally seeing a neurologist the 12th at half 9. Wants me to go with her. I'm driving her there.

Eilidh and Connor's anniversary is end of the month, ten years. Connor's planning a weekend in the Highlands but Eilidh doesn't know. Apparently she's been dropping hints about a proper walking jacket.
Caroline's back from her surgery and sounds much brighter. Stitches out Monday morning. Her sister Gemma's staying with her till the weekend.
Vanessa's dog Rolo turned 5 yesterday, she threw him an actual party with a cake. Honestly brilliant.
Need to ring Tendai tomorrow evening about the dog sitting. They're away the 3rd to the 10th and the kennel let them down.

Ayesha told me over lunch that her mum's been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. Family's taking it in turns to help her sort her meals. Ayesha's vegetarian anyway so she's been cooking for her. She seemed tired but ok.
Dev's starting a new job at the hospital in January, pharmacy team. Ethan's thrilled for him, they've been waiting ages for something local.
Quick catch up with Elif. Her son broke his wrist falling off the trampoline Saturday. Cast for six weeks. She's knackered. Must send her something cheering this week.
Andile's hamster died. Kids were devastated, he says. Burial in the garden this evening.
Sofia is pregnant!! Due sometime in May. Karim's over the moon. She's had awful morning sickness so has been off work a fair bit. Don't mention it to anyone at work yet.
Nora's grandad passed away last week. Funeral is Wednesday at 11 in Dundee. She's flying up Tuesday night. I should send flowers to her mum's.
Lola got the kitten in the end - tabby, called Mango. Vaccinations Friday at 2.
Petra Novak from next door says her husband's off work with his back again. Thinks it'll be weeks. Offered to walk their dog while he's laid up.
Seo-yeon's driving test is Thursday at 10 and she's a wreck about it, failed twice already. Text her good luck Wednesday night.
Neha mentioned Santiago's had a nasty flu since the weekend, properly floored. Their trip to Lisbon next Friday might have to be pushed back. Check how he is on Monday.

Dinner at Chantal's. Kofi was there too. Chantal's cat Mabel needs a dental op sometime next month, costing a fortune. Kofi's learning Portuguese for a trip with his brother Emre in the summer. Kofi's also doing a half marathon in early April, first one. Chantal is gluten free, worth remembering for the Christmas do.
Dentist for me Tuesday at 8.15. Then car MOT sometime that week.
Yusuf's daughter Lena has tonsillitis again, third time this year. Consultant appointment after Christmas to talk about taking them out. He's worried she's missing so much school.
Adriana Reyes - new neighbour across the road, works nights as a nurse. Has two greyhounds. Lovely.

Thomas and Alice are thinking about getting a rescue dog sometime in the new year. Alice is allergic to cats so it has to be a dog. Thomas wants a big one, Alice wants small. Could send them that link to the greyhound rescue.

Varun called. His mum fell over on Sunday and has a fractured hip, operation was yesterday. She's in for at least a week. He's back and forth to the hospital after work every day and sounds shattered. Kiara's covering school pickups. I need to check in with him on Thursday, and maybe drop a lasagne round at the weekend.
Hoang said the neurologist appointment went fine, no scans needed. Huge relief.
Emre's cockapoo Bailey went missing on the common Saturday afternoon, found him Sunday morning in someone's shed. Emre still shaken.

Eilidh's brother Connor is coming down from Glasgow over the summer for a few weeks. He's recovering from long covid and still gets wiped out easily. She wants to take him to the coast if he's up to it.
Caroline's thinking of retiring end of next year. Hasn't decided. Her husband retired in June and is driving her mad apparently.
Remind me to call Gemma Friday at lunchtime. Her MRI results should be back by then and she'll want to talk it through.

Lovely long walk with Vanessa and her new puppy Fudge. Fudge is a lab cross, 12 weeks, chewed through Vanessa's charger already. Vanessa's off to Crete with her partner Tendai sometime in late September. Her mum's going to have Fudge while they're away, which Vanessa's nervous about. Also she's started pottery classes on Tuesday nights and loves it.
Tendai's mum is having a cataract op on the 21st first thing in the morning. He's taking her in and staying the day.
Ayesha and Dev are hosting a housewarming sometime early December. Date tbc. Ayesha said bring nothing but I'll take a plant.
Ethan's knee is playing up again and he's had to pull out of the 10k on Sunday. Gutted. Physio says rest for a month at least.
Elif mentioned her daughter has her first ever ballet show the 14th at 6pm. She's nervous, practising every night in the kitchen.
Text Andile tonight re: Saturday.
Sofia and Karim's little one Nora has had a temperature since last night. GP squeezed her in this afternoon at 4.40. Sofia sounded frazzled. Ask Sofia tomorrow morning how Nora got on.
Kiara's guinea pigs have names now: Salt and Pepper. Not much else to report, she's loving her art foundation course.

Called Lola. Her mum's had a minor stroke, in hospital in Bristol. Lola's going down tomorrow morning and doesn't know for how long. She was trying to hold it together. Her boss has been decent about time off. I said I'd feed her cat Ziggy while she's gone, need to get her spare key tonight. Must call her at the weekend.
Petra's birthday is the 9th of November. She's into houseplants and keeps saying she wants a big monstera.
Seo-yeon passed her test!! Third time lucky. Celebrating Friday night at the Korean place.
Neha's starting chemo sometime next month. She was so matter of fact about it. Her husband Santiago is going part time to be with her. I want to organise a meal rota with the others.
Caught up with Santiago at the school gate. His dog Luna had an operation on her leg last week and is wearing the cone of shame. Their son is in a play the Thursday before Christmas.
Chantal's mum is in a care home now, settled in ok. Chantal visits Sundays around 2. She seems lighter than she has for months.
Kofi and Adriana are getting married next summer, venue still not booked. Kofi's mum is insisting on a church. Adriana's sister Sofia is going to be maid of honour.
Thomas has got shingles of all things. Off work till at least the end of next week. Send him that podcast list.
Must book the vet for our cat's jabs sometime before the end of the month.
Varun's mum is out of hospital and staying with them. Walking with a frame. He said thanks for the lasagne.

Lunch with Alice and Yusuf. Alice has a job interview Monday at 11 for the head of design role, she's anxious because it's a panel of five. Yusuf's off to Istanbul for his cousin's wedding mid November. Alice's cat Toffee is 15 now and going a bit deaf.
Eilidh's elderly spaniel Hector had to be put to sleep this morning. She's heartbroken, had him since uni. Don't forget to send her a card this week.

Connor rang. His dad's had a heart scare, stents put in on Tuesday. Doing well, home by Friday hopefully. Connor's going up to Inverness for a long weekend sometime soon to help out. He's been running on empty.
Gemma mentioned her son Ethan has his GCSE mocks in early January and is really stressing. She's thinking of getting him a tutor after Christmas. Ethan's into chess, plays for the school.
Vanessa's puppy Fudge has kennel cough. Poor thing. Vet said a week of rest, no walks.
Dev Kaur - Ayesha's cousin, met at the housewarming. Vet nurse, has three rescue cats. Big Arsenal fan.

Hoang said her dad's had a fall at home, nothing broken but he's shaken and bruised. Her brother Karim is staying with him for a few days. She's going over Saturday at around 10 to take him to his GP follow up. Should ring Hoang Sunday afternoon.
Petra is fostering kittens over the winter. Has four at the moment, all tiny. Wants to keep the ginger one. Her partner Emre says absolutely not.
Nothing major from Elif's. Kids fine, house chaos, she's off to her in-laws at Easter as usual.
